title: docs: update README — 2026-09-30
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt: Daily README update: Latest News and star history. Recent Apps is refreshed when an app is published.

gist.headline: The garden log gets a refresh
gist.blurb: The README has today’s news and refreshed star-history charts. Even the garden log needs a new page now and then.
gist.summary: The September 30 README update refreshes Latest News and the light and dark GitHub star-history charts, keeping the project overview current.
gist.impact: README readers can see the latest project news and updated star-history charts in either theme.
gist.visual_concept: Show the pollinations.ai bee updating a garden noticeboard labeled README, with a small news sheet and two star-chart cards for light and dark themes. Polli wears a tiny editor’s visor; flowers and a growing vine make the routine update feel like tending a garden.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden shed, Polli pins a fresh news sheet beside two tiny star-history charts on a README noticeboard, while lime green (#ecf874) vines curl around the frame.
